title: Functions
intro: Learn the basic ideas of Functions in simple English. Read the explanation and example first; the quiz asks only from the concepts taught here.

items.heading: What is a function?
items.text: A function is a reusable block of code that performs a task. It is defined with def.
items.code:
def add(a, b):
    return a + b

items.heading: Function definition
items.text: A function definition gives the function a name, parameters and a body.

items.heading: Function call
items.text: Calling a function runs its body.

items.heading: Parameter
items.text: A parameter is a named input written in a function definition.

items.heading: Argument
items.text: An argument is the value supplied when a function is called.

items.heading: return
items.text: return sends a value back to the caller and ends that function execution.

items.heading: Default parameter
items.text: A parameter can have a default value used when the caller does not provide one.

items.heading: Local variable
items.text: A variable created inside a function normally belongs to that function’s local scope.

items.heading: Scope
items.text: Scope describes where a name can be accessed. Python has local, enclosing, global and built-in name scopes.

items.heading: Multiple return values
items.text: A function can return multiple values; Python commonly packages them into a tuple.

items.heading: *args
items.text: *args collects extra positional arguments into a tuple inside the function.

items.heading: **kwargs
items.text: **kwargs collects extra keyword arguments into a dictionary.
